title: Twill
description: A 2/2 twill appears float by float along the diagonal.
alt: Short rounded bars, peach, blue and rose across and pale linen down, appear in a diagonal sweep to form the slanted ribs of a twill cloth, then clear in the same direction.
note: Giving the rule for the weave as arithmetic, weft on top where (column − row) mod 4 is 0 or 1, yields a correct twill. Grouping the floats by diagonal lets one delay per group drive a hundred shapes and keeps the file small.
author: Maria Roszyk
